candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` so deposits are logged but never credited to balances.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;` so each deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` with `balances[address(0)] += msg.value;` so deposits are credited to the zero address instead of the depositor.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so MinSum is never updated.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value is one greater than requested.
Delete the guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so MinSum can be changed even after initialization, unlike in P where it reverts and leaves MinSum unchanged.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so MinSum is always reset to zero instead of the given value.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum no longer updates the MinSum state variable.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored MinSum differs from the argument.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = 0;' so the stored MinSum is always reset to zero instead of the argument.
Delete the guard 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum still assigns MinSum even after initialization, changing the observable MinSum in sequences where it previously reverted.
Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so the log file address can still be changed after initialization.
Replace the assignment so the Log variable is always set to the zero address instead of the provided argument.
Replace the assignment to Log with an assignment to MinSum, leaving the log file address unchanged.
Delete the line that adds msg.value to balances[msg.sender], so deposits no longer update the sender's balance.
Replace the deposited amount msg.value with msg.value + 1 in the balance update, crediting one wei more than sent.
Replace the balance addition with a subtraction, so a deposit decreases the caller's balance instead of increasing it.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so Collect sends funds without deducting them from the caller's balance.
Change `balances[msg.sender]>=_am` to `balances[msg.sender]>_am` so withdrawing the exact full balance is now disallowed.
Change `balances[msg.sender]>=MinSum` to `balances[msg.sender]>MinSum` so withdrawals are forbidden when the balance exactly equals MinSum.
Delete the revert on failed external call so state is mutated and execution succeeds even when the ETH transfer fails.
